preview.text: South Korea and Indonesia meet for their tenth recorded T20 match at Yeonhui Cricket Ground, where South Korea has won 2 and Indonesia 7 of the previous 9 encounters. South Korea won the toss and chose to bowl first at the venue, which has a usual first-innings score of 119 across 23 recorded T20 matches. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and a temperature of about 16 degrees.

summary.text: South Korea won by 8 wkts. IDN made 99-10, Kadek Gamantika top-scoring with 37 off 38 balls; Aamir Lal took 5 for 16. SKR made 102-2, Balage Dilruksha (c & wk) top-scoring with 64 off 42 balls; Kadek Gamantika took 1 for 15. Sides batting first at Yeonhui Cricket Ground usually make about 119.
